_doc: Vũ Linh Đường's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py under source world-depth:vu_linh.

Heard Through the Roots.rule: Canon of the Bells in the Canopy (passive art, layer 4): the first strike each fight against you while you hold a Bell charge is warned (+30 pp evade) and partly evaded (if it still lands, it deals half damage).

Tuned Bronze.rule: Seal of the Listening Bell (passive art, layer 4): your bells and wards resist soul (+15 % soul resistance) and charm (+20 % status resistance against Charmed) arts; each soul art that lands on you or charm art you evade or stop rings and slows its caster (1 Slowed Time stack for 3 s, and +0.5 s delay on their next art).
Tuned Bronze.approx: Always grants soul_res 15 and status_resist 20 (status: charmed); rings and slows the foe on soul_taken, or on evaded / hit_stopped with tag charm.

Clear Note.rule: Clear Bell: your ward rings when it is struck; each time it absorbs damage, the foe's next art is delayed by 0.5 s (at most once every 3 seconds).

The Forest Hears.rule: Banner of the Root Line: the foe is seen from the start of a fight (+25 accuracy for 8 s), and the first ambush on you fails (1 decoy at fight start).
The Forest Hears.approx: No stealth ambush phase in 1v1 fight.py; grants 1 opening decoy and +25 acc for 8.0 s at fight_start.

The Line Is Tuned.rule: Bells on the Roads, full set (3 pieces): your ward bells are linked. When any of them absorbs a hit, the striker gains 1 Slowed Time stack plus 1 per hung Canopy Bell (for 3 s). When the foe reaches 5 Slowed Time stacks, they take the pour (2.0 c Fire damage) and the bells pause adding Slowed Time for 3 s while the stacks clear.
The Line Is Tuned.approx: Engine has no foe-side status consume; uses a 3 s pour_cd charge (each_for 3.0) so bells pause Slowed Time while the 3 s curse clears naturally, and approximates 'worth your apron's attack' with free_hit c 2.0 dtype fire (scaling with the apron's Fire attack_pct).
